The same SS source geometry is used for authored visual finish presets; no alternate alloy geometry, measured reflectance or offer/order compatibility is claimed.
handEvidence: Fine straight central hands pictured in blue (steel watch) and rose (rose-gold and platinum watches). Blue source assignments also support retained Lance/Open lance. No rose-gold evidence for those two shapes: selector disables it and changing shape normalizes to blue with live feedback. Skeleton finishes unchanged.

Fine colors follow case material by explicit user direction; this is not an order configurator.
